issue.title: [9332][platform_tests] TestChassisFan::test_get_speed fails due to a few fan speeds returned as RPM

failure.body:
#### Description

test_get_speed expects fan speed in percentage (value 0 to 100), but some fan speeds are returned as RPM value. This issue is seen intermittently

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run TestChassisFan::test_get_speed on 9332

#### Describe the results you received:
```
show platform fan
  Drawer    LED            FAN    Speed    Direction     Presence    Status          Timestamp
--------  -----  -------------  -------  -----------  -----------  --------  -----------------
FanTray1    N/A  FanTray1-Fan1      99%      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray1    N/A  FanTray1-Fan2   121RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray2    N/A  FanTray2-Fan1     100%      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray2    N/A  FanTray2-Fan2   121RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray3    N/A  FanTray3-Fan1     100%      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray3    N/A  FanTray3-Fan2   120RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray4    N/A  FanTray4-Fan1   101RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray4    N/A  FanTray4-Fan2   121RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray5    N/A  FanTray5-Fan1     100%      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray5    N/A  FanTray5-Fan2   122RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray6    N/A  FanTray6-Fan1   101RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray6    N/A  FanTray6-Fan2   122RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray7    N/A  FanTray7-Fan1   102RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
FanTray7    N/A  FanTray7-Fan2   122RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
     N/A    N/A       PSU1 Fan      N/A          N/A  Not Present       N/A  20210901 <IPV6>
     N/A    N/A       PSU2 Fan   110RPM      exhaust      Present        OK  20210901 <IPV6>
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
Speed output should be consistently returned as percentage
